title: Quantization profile delta-heatmap and adaptive fidelity thresholds
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build an automated eval and alerting flow that ties quantization profile changes (AWQ/GPTQ, int8/int4, mixed-precision) to measurable quality regressions and produces an explainable delta-heatmap at layer/head granularity plus an adaptive threshold policy for rollout gating. Scope: implement experiment matrix generation, delta-heatmap visualizer, metric aggregation, adaptive threshold algorithm (cost-sensitive + quantile-based), and a rollout gating proposal integrated with the existing eval harness and rollback playbook. Out of scope: full on-call incident handling and platform billing changes (separate follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: Automated job that runs quantized vs float baselines across the target experiment matrix and outputs a per-layer/per-head delta-heatmap (JSON + PNG) for each model/profile combination
Heatmap artifacts are uploaded to the eval dashboard and linked from the job run summary (PRD/drive link)

Adaptive threshold algorithm implemented and evaluated: produces candidate thresholds that balance cost saving targets with quality delta constraints; thresholds expressed as metric deltas and a composite fidelity score
Regression alert rule that triggers when composite fidelity delta exceeds threshold for production cohorts and produces actionable diagnostics (top contributing layers/heads, example prompts)
Playbook section describing safe rollout gating (canary size, automatic rollback condition) and mitigation steps when a threshold is breached
Benchmarks demonstrating end-to-end run for at least 3 models (one LLM-7B-class, one LLM-13B-class, one LLM-70B-class) and both AWQ and GPTQ profiles with int8 and int4 where feasible
evaluation_matrix: Metrics: composite_fidelity_score (weighted sum of EM/Exact-Match delta, semantic-similarity cosine on embeddings, answer correctness rate, calibrated logit-KL, and hallucination_rate), token_perplexity_delta, topk_distribution_shift (KL), per-example L2 on logits
Datasets: internal_prompt_suite_cohort_A (real customer prompts), MMLU, SQuAD v2, TruthfulQA subset, codegen_small (code-focused prompts), n-shot conversational transcripts
Aggregation: per-cohort quantiles (50/90/95), per-prompt severity buckets, and cohort-level mean/median deltas
Temporal: run at sequence lengths 64 and 512 to capture prefix-sensitive regressions
experiments: Matrix axes: quantizer {AWQ, GPTQ} x bitwidth {int8, int4} x profile_variant {per-layer mixed, uniform} x KV_cache {on, off} x seq_len {64, 512}
Run float32 baseline then run each quantized variant and compute per-token and per-sequence deltas; keep raw logits for distribution comparison
Isolation experiments: when a delta hotspot is detected in the heatmap, re-run with single-layer quantization to confirm the layer/head responsible
Cost sensitivity sweep: compute cost savings (inference token cost estimate) vs fidelity delta to determine Pareto frontier and feed to adaptive threshold generator
Human-in-the-loop validation: for top 20 failing examples per cohort, collect human annotations (accept/reject/notes) to calibrate composite_fidelity_score weights
runbook_steps: 1) Launch baseline float32 run for target model + datasets (job template: eval/quant/baseline).
2) Execute experiment matrix runs (parallelized by model/profile) and upload raw outputs to eval-storage bucket.
3) Generate delta-heatmaps (layer x head) and per-example delta tables; create PNG/JSON artifacts.
4) Run adaptive threshold routine: compute candidate thresholds for composite_fidelity_score using quantile clipping and cost-sensitivity parameter (configurable).
5) Emit alert if any cohort 95th percentile delta > threshold; attach diagnostics (top layers, example prompts, PR links).
6) If alert triggers in staging/dedicated: follow rollout gating playbook — block promotion to prod, revert to previous profile, or apply per-layer white-listing.
7) Postmortem template: capture root cause (quantizer, profile, dataset), mitigation, and follow-up tasks (e.g., re-train profile or adjust KV cache policy).
progress_updates: 2026-03-04: Ticket created and scoping reviewed with Research and Prod; agreed on composite_fidelity_score formulation and datasets.

2026-03-07: Prototype heatmap generator implemented (Python + matplotlib) and produces interpretable PNGs for LLM-7B runs; stored under drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/quant-heatmaps/ENG-88101/prototype

2026-03-09: Initial AWQ-int8 runs completed for model-7B; observed localized degradation in codegen_small BLEU for prompts that exercise deep attention context; created follow-up ENG-88145 to isolate head-level rounding behavior.

2026-03-12: Adaptive threshold routine v0 implemented (50/90 quantile + cost weight) and evaluated on historical runs — produces conservative thresholds that correlate with human rejection in 85% of sampled examples.

2026-03-14: Integration started with eval-harness; discovered performance bottleneck in log collection step when preserving full logits (file size explosion). Investigating streaming/summary approach.
notes: Keep artifacts lightweight: prefer layer/head summaries and sampled logits over full dumps to control storage costs.
Priority is enabling a reliable rollback/whitelist path before aggressive cost-saving profiles are exposed to production traffic.
Follow-up ticket planned to surface heatmap diagnostics in the Console under model-run details.
Coordinate with SRE to ensure long-running eval jobs do not interfere with Dedicated pools during business hours.
